usage: 埃及 is the proper noun for the country Egypt in Cantonese.
It is used as a subject or object in a sentence when talking about the country or its culture.
You can use 埃及 with verbs related to travel, history, or geography.
When referring to Egyptian-related things, you can say 埃及嘅 to mean 'Egyptian'.
埃及 can be combined with other nouns to specify places, e.g., 埃及金字塔 (Egypt pyramids).
